title: Diversification Across Asset Classes: Beyond a Single Color
summary: GOLD-L2-009: Diversification Across Asset Classes: Beyond a Single Color.
body: This GOLD Level 2 lesson develops practical investment competence in Diversification Across Asset Classes: Beyond a Single Color. Learners should compare alternatives, understand the relationship between risk and expected return, test assumptions and downside scenarios, and consider diversification, liquidity, costs, taxation, time horizon and broader financial goals. Investment products, tax treatment and regulatory protections vary by jurisdiction and can change, so current official information or qualified local professional advice should be used where relevant. The objective is informed decision-making and structured analysis, not a recommendation to buy or sell any specific investment.
